title: Retire automatic mailbox routing safely on explicit role or central replacement
outcome: An explicit operator role/central replacement can retire automatic routing without migrating or reviving old-domain history or outcomes; explicit execution grants keep their current replacement fences.
acceptance: Only an explicit operator role or central replacement retires automatic routing; ordinary operations never clear or silently rebind it.
Old-domain history and immutable delivery outcomes remain unchanged; pending or unacknowledged retired routes surface explicit old-domain-unavailable with a reason and cannot reroute, drop or revive.
Existing explicit execution grants and bindings continue blocking replacement as before.
Disposable regressions cover automatic-only replacement with explicit unavailability and explicit-grant refusal; required review and validation cover the exact input.
